shortfalls.gap: Launching the E2E app repeatedly deleted four tracked QQBot skill files under openclaw_runtime/extensions/qqbot/skills/ during Gateway startup, leaving the git worktree dirty until manually restored. Root cause is not yet identified; plugin-skills publish and trim functions are candidates, but a standard junction removal probe did not reproduce target deletion.
shortfalls.observed: git status showed 'D openclaw_runtime/extensions/qqbot/skills/qqbot-channel/SKILL.md' plus 3 sibling files after each of two E2E launches. Files were restored with git restore --source=HEAD. Repo HEAD was unchanged and no source edit was intended.
shortfalls.impact: Any E2E or normal startup path that deletes tracked source files corrupts the working tree and can silently alter packaged inputs. It also makes clean-candidate evidence unreliable.
shortfalls.proposedAction: Instrument skill-root cleanup paths to log path, realpath, link type and decision before deletion; add an E2E guard that fails when tracked files change; then fix and rerun the full E2E suite.
shortfalls.blastRadius: tracked source inputs during E2E; may invalidate clean-candidate and package evidence
shortfalls.pathToGa: instrument deletion paths, add a tracked-file mutation guard and rerun launch/full E2E
